text:
maria: Quick heads-up — planning a small routing/TTL tweak for eu-edge tonight. Target window 23:00-23:30 UTC. Goal: reduce DNS TTL from 300 -> 60 and shift traffic weight from eu-primary to eu-canary for a brief bake (95/5 -> 98/2 then back). Who can kick and watch smoke?
kevin: I can be on the shift. ETA for me to join: 22:50 UTC. What exact sequence are we running?
priya: Sequence I propose: 1) pre-checks 22:50 (health + logs) 2) apply TTL change 23:00 3) route weight tweak to 98/2 23:05 4) 10m bake, perf checks 5) if clean, revert weights to normal and TTL stays at 60 for 24h. Rollback = set weights back + TTL 300.
ash: +1 on rollback plan. Also recommend setting service-level canary limits: drop canary to 0% within 2m if errors spike.
maria: Sounds good. Priya, can you paste the smoke checklist here?
priya: Smoke checklist: 
- curl health endpoints from eu region and from external (curl -H 'Host: api.redwood.ai' https://eu-edge.internal/health)
- check p50/p95 latency dashboards (edge-eu route)
- tail nginx/gateway logs for 5m for 5xx spike: `kubectl logs -n infra -l app=edge-gateway --since=5m`
- run small synthetic: `wrk -t2 -c20 -d60s https://eu-edge.api/preview`
- confirm CDN TTL honors new record with dig: `dig +short @8.8.8.8 api.redwood.ai A`
kevin: Note: when TTL goes to 60, some resolvers will still cache older values — give 10m to observe drift. We'll watch for 504s.
maria: I'll be the primary operator for the DNS change. Priya, can you make the Route53 change JSON and put it in /infra/dns/changes/ so we can apply?
priya: Done. file: /infra/dns/changes/eu-edge-ttl-60.json. Change batch uses hosted-zone ID Z12345EU. Command: 
```
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z12345EU --change-batch file://eu-edge-ttl-60.json
```
deploy-bot: Scheduled DNS change in deploy queue at 2026-03-18T23:00:00Z by maria. Runbook: /docs/runbooks/edge-dns-shift.md
ash: I'll run the weight shift after DNS change completes. I'll do incremental 95->98->100 if bake looks good, but we'll keep canary at 2% only for 10m.
kevin: Who's on rollback if we see issues? I'll accept if needed. Also, runbook says we should pre-create an emergency change to re-instate old weights quickly — can someone create that now?
priya: Creating rollback change now: /infra/routing/rollbacks/eu-edge-weights-restore.json. Command to flip: `kubectl apply -f eu-edge-weights-restore.json -n infra-routing`
maria: Thanks. Timing confirmed: I'll apply TTL at 23:00, deploy-bot will log the change. Ash will trigger weight tweak at 23:05. Priya will run smoke checks and post updates. Kevin will own rollback execution.
kevin: I'll be ready at 23:00-23:20 UTC. Please ping me on thread when you apply.
priya: I'll post checkpoints: pre-checks done (22:52), TTL applied (23:00), weights moved to 98/2 (23:05), bake OK (23:15) or escalate.
maria: Pre-checks done?
priya: Pre-checks: health endpoints OK, no 5xx in last 15m, p95 within baseline. All good.
ash: Ready to execute weights at my signal.
priya: TTL applied at 23:00. Change ID: C123456789. dig shows TTL ~60 from 3/4 resolvers.
kevin: seeing a few 502s in gateway logs right after change — small spike 23:02-23:03. Is that resolvers catching old IPs?
ash: I'm starting canary shift to 98/2 now.
priya: 502 spike looks transient, 5xx rate back to baseline. tail logs show reconnects from a handful of clients.
maria: good call. Ash, proceed with 98/2.
ash: Done. Weights at 98/2 at 23:06.
priya: Running smoke script now. wrk run shows p95 within 10% of baseline. No error spike.
kevin: Confirming no sustained 5xx. I'll hold on rollback unless we see sustained increase over 1%.
maria: Bake complete. Reverting canary weight to normal at 23:18 and keeping TTL 60 for 24h.
ash: Reverted to normal weights at 23:19.
priya: Final checks pass. Marking this shift successful. I'll file a short post in #eng-release with the change ID and summary.
maria: Thanks everyone. Action items: priya -> post summary, kevin -> keep an eye on p95 for next 2h, ash -> follow up on any log anomalies. :thumbsup:
kevin: On it.
deploy-bot: Change C123456789 completed and closed.
